description: Jung Yeonshin was born with a short fate, destined to die before reaching the age of twenty. Despite being looked down upon by his family, he possesses extraordinary talent and even creates his own martial arts. When he discovers that his remaining lifespan is rapidly running out, Yeonshin begins a desperate struggle to overcome his fate and survive in the brutal martial world.
author: JP / Cheongsiso
